failure_cause: All 23 recorded failures were POST /v1/triage HTTP 500s caused by httpx.ReadTimeout at the API-to-vLLM 45-second timeout. No QA failures, Locust exceptions, or rate-limit 429s were recorded.
interpretation: The complete 20-user run demonstrates the current triage serving path is not stable at this concurrency. The configured vLLM max-num-seqs is 1; queued generation is a likely contributor to the timeouts. QA remained fast. This is one local stress run, not a production capacity estimate.
privacy_observation: vLLM INFO logs during the run include the model prompt text. Requests were synthetic; avoid real customer data until prompt logging is disabled or appropriately redacted.
